# gregwar/captcha v1.3.0 (vendored subset)

From https://github.com/Gregwar/Captcha, tag v1.3.0, MIT licence (see `LICENSE`).
Only the files the image CAPTCHA needs are copied: the builders, their interfaces and the fonts.
`ImageFileHandler` (background images, needs symfony/finder) is left out. Loaded by `src/bootstrap.php`.
